summary: The reel maintains a consistent flat2D vector style with accurate character gripping and scaling. Some scenes contain minor repetition of character lineups and text element alignments, but overall the visual logic holds up well.

clean: Shot 0: Character correctly holds the mate gourd with proper hand wrapping.
Shot 7: Yasy luna figure correctly shown in white with a crescent moon symbol.
Shot 11: Figures properly share the mate inside the hut scene.
unclean: Shot 3: Multiple duplicated figures lined up consecutively without narrative progression.
Shot 5: Duplicated figure crowd composition repeats heavily from previous shots.

clean: Consistent color palette and flat vector art style across all scenes.
Clear UI text box separation from character actions in upper sections.
unclean: Shot 1: Timeline/comparison graphics slightly overlap background windows.

issues.problem: Identical row of multiple figures repeated across consecutive frames.
issues.fix: Vary character poses or reduce redundant figure arrays.
